manifesto.title: Timeless architectural principles, modern engineering code.
manifesto.p1: Durability is the primary rule taught by ancient Mesopotamian stone masonry. We approach software with the same ethos — avoiding transient hype and unnecessary complexity to build clean, enduring systems.
manifesto.p2: End-to-end type safety and a rock-solid backbone on the backend; a smooth 60 FPS, accessible, and clutter-free experience on the frontend.

bio.subtitle: A full-stack engineer architecting deterministic systems; a designer with typographic intuition and human-centered ergonomics.
bio.totemDesc: Sculptural brand emblem inspired by Urfa limestone carvings and sundial geometry.
bio.quote: Engineering is the discipline of eliminating the unnecessary. Ancient stone walls teach us one enduring lesson:
bio.quoteHighlight: Only that which withstands time endures.
bio.narrativeP1: In modern software, products often split into extremes: either visually striking but fragile, slow, and unmaintainable web interfaces; or technically stable but lifeless, poorly typed, and ergonomically clumsy portals.
bio.narrativeP2: I eliminate that friction. On the backend, I build secure, strictly typed, and high-throughput pipelines using C#/.NET and TypeScript; on the frontend, I deliver accessible, smooth 60 FPS interfaces with zero perceived latency.
bio.narrativeFocus: [ FOCUS: C# / .NET 9 · TYPESCRIPT · NEXT.JS · POSTGRESQL · DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS · RUST / WASM ]

craftLab.title: Craft Lab & Micro-Physics
craftLab.subtitle: Built from mathematical primitives rather than borrowed packages: spring kinetics, deterministic crypto blocks, and Web Audio tactile synthesis.
craftLab.exp1Desc: Drag and fling the Nahit stone tile. Adjust stiffness and damping parameters live to experience physical motion budgets.
craftLab.exp2Desc: Every input keypress deterministic 256-bit block partitioning. Translating backend systems architecture into frontend tactile clarity.
craftLab.exp3Desc: Zero external mp3 assets. A pure 40ms damped sine click synthesized directly via Web Audio API, mimicking a Leica mechanical shutter.
